title: The Cover of the Free Port
author: Paloma Quintana
blurb: Ansel Vasquez, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
